summary: Morgan Stanley Capital I Trust 2020-L4 filed a routine Form 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that, effective September 10, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC replaced CWCapital Asset Management LLC as special servicer for the 545 Washington Boulevard mortgage loan and related pari passu and subordinate notes, a non-serviced loan combination governed by the BANK 2020-BNK25 pooling and servicing agreement. Torchlight was appointed at the direction of directing certificateholder BNK 25 CCR, LLC. Servicing continues under the existing PSA. No deal terms, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are stated; this is an ordinary CMBS servicing change, not a special situation.
